probing_questions: How are things classified in this domain, and what do the categories reveal?
Which stated criterion includes an instance in a category, and what would exclude it?
Which named instances does the text assign to each category, under which criterion?
How do the classifications nest, intersect or cross-cut one another?
Where does the text contest a criterion or supply a borderline case, and what does changing that threshold change?

problematique: A category/criterion/instance inventory plus a boundary-and-overlap table showing nonexclusive membership, disputed cases and criteria that change by context. Preserve the author’s classifications and competing attributed definitions before judging their consequences. A text or supplied collection containing classifications, criteria and relevant instances.
researcher_question: How does the text classify the domain, and where are its criteria or memberships contested?
